title: East Nashville Haven | Modern Boho Retreat!
description:
Relax at this quiet, cozy, and peaceful East Nashville retreat only 15 minutes from downtown and close to fun East Nashville restaurants and bars. Easy access by Uber to Nissan Stadium, the Grand Ole Opry, or Broadway! Less than 5 minutes from Skyline Medical Center. Long-time Airbnb owners host this space.

The space
You will be staying in our owner-occupied, private, and self contained suite.  This space has its own separate entrance, free on-site parking and can sleep up to 6 guests. It has a queen bed, two twin beds, and a full-sized pull out couch. There is a kitchenette with a full dining space, a spacious living room with TV and board games, and an updated bathroom. 

With easy access to nearby restaurants and a short uber to ride to downtown Nashville, the Grand Ole Opry, and Nissan Stadium, your stay can be a peaceful retreat from the busyness of downtown Nashville. Or with wifi and our comfy space, you can have a getaway from the office, and a work from home minutes from the downtown nightlife. We live in the lower level of the home and will be on site to answer any questions or assist with anything you might need as guests.

Guest access
Access the bnb via the staircase on the right side of the house. Free parking is available on the gravel pad to the right of the driveway. Continue walking along the gravel path and up the stairs and you will find the door on the side of the home  with a keypad to access the bnb.

Other things to note
The bnb has a kitchenette with a refrigerator, microwave, toaster, coffee maker,  and full sets of dishes. The living room is stocked with games and is outfitted with a Roku TV with access to streaming services like Netflix and Disney Plus that you are welcome to login to!
